name: Spooky-cute night
one_line: Purple sky, friendly ghosts and glowing pumpkins.
look_words: A friendly haunted night. Purple and plum ground under a deep violet sky with a crescent moon; twisty bare trees, wonky fences and a crooked little house. Everything is rounded and cartoonish, so nothing is truly scary. Low green mist curls along the ground. Pumpkin orange glows mark things to collect and windows to visit, ghostly green marks the goal, hot pink-red is harm, and the player is white. Light is dim violet moonlight with small warm pools around lanterns and pumpkins. Motion is bobbing and floaty: ghosts drift, bats flap, flames flicker, eyes blink in the dark. Avoid gore, realism, jump scares, grey murk, and bloom that smears the glows.

palette.name: purple night
palette.notes: Moonlight is violet, not blue. Orange is the reward colour here, so harm is pink-red to stay clear of it.

look_wish: outlines and flat fills with soft drawn glows, or none

upgrade.why: wisps and glowing things that drift, blink and react to the player
real little flames for candles, lanterns and pumpkins

music.mood: sneaky pizzicato, theremin and a soft organ

sound_feel: hoots, creaks, soft whooshes, a silly rattle of bones
